# 📄 Embed any page

A **Wiki Page** card can embed any embeddable http(s) page, not just a wiki page — set **Custom URL** in ⚙.

This board frames an [Objectium](https://objectium.toolforge.org) 3D model (GLB, CC0, Smithsonian). Drag inside the card to rotate it.

```json
{ "widgetType": "wikiPage",
  "config": { "url": "https://objectium.toolforge.org/uploads/213" } }
```

Sites that send `X-Frame-Options: DENY` (or an enforced `frame-ancestors`) can't be framed — everything else can.
